FN-FOJEDC-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 254
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Steve Clouse
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/11/2023
House Bill 254 as introduced would require that any motor fuel tax, license tax, or other related
taxes levied by a county or municipality only be used for road and bridge construction and
maintenance. However, this bill would allow the counties and municipalities currently pledging
those revenues as security or to fund the payment of bond or debt obligations to continue to do
so for up to five years. This bill also requires future motor fuel taxes proposed by a municipality
or county to be approved by local referendum, if that locality is currently using any portion of a
motor fuel tax for a purpose other than road and bridge construction and maintenance.

FN-FOJEDC-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 254
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Steve Clouse
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 04/20/2023
House Bill 254 as reported by the Committee on County and Municipal Government would
require that any motor fuel tax, license tax, or other related taxes levied by a county or
municipality after the effective date of this act only be used for the cost of: 1) administering the
tax; 2) construction, reconstruction, maintenance, repair of roads, bridges, and right of ways; 3)
traffic regulation; and 4) enforcement of traffic and motor vehicles.
